claims.claim: localsafe.eth (Cyfrin, MIT) calls itself early development, supports Safe v1.4.1 only, has no history, last release v0.3.1 on June 18, 2026.
claims.method: GitHub API: MIT, releases v0.3.1 on 2026-06-18, 0.3.0, 0.2.10. README disclaimer says still in early development; checklist items list transaction history and other contract versions as not yet done.
The page returns HTTP 200 with a small page. Capability was not exercised.

claims.claim: Eternal Safe is a GPL-3.0 fork of Safe{Wallet} v1.26.2 that needs only an RPC URL, funded by the Safe Grants Program, with encoded not encrypted smart links.
claims.method: README states fork at v1.26.2, funded by the Safe Grants Program, no backend services beyond an RPC URL, smart links encoded not encrypted. GitHub API license GPL-3.0. devanoneth is the third contributor listed; the proposal's statement that Devan Non maintains it was not matched to a profile.
GitHub API: repository owner pcaversaccio, AGPL-3.0, last push 2026-11-16.

claims.claim: Bybit's Safe{Wallet} frontend was compromised in February 2025 (about $1.5B).
claims.method: Chainalysis text: nearly $1.5 billion lost, attackers added malicious JavaScript to the Safe UI frontend code after taking control of a Safe developer's computer.
